reference: 2x the largest CSS size in a 1920x1080 window; Sprite pixels per unit 200 makes native size equal that CSS size

conventions.box: where the web svg box lies in the sprite, px from the sprite top-left [x, y, w, h] (x, y can be negative); the web sizes and rotates that box, and the art may overflow it
conventions.offset: px from the frame top-left (dog: web box; bubble_tail: bubble bottom centre) to the sprite top-left; y down
conventions.border: Unity sprite border in px [left, bottom, right, top] (Vector4 order); drawMode says sliced, tiled, or tiled-whole (tile the whole sprite)
conventions.dogStack: draw every _ink sprite, then every _pad sprite, then the art sprites, in the listed order
conventions.tint: white art meant to be tinted with a palette colour

small.where: tour bus on the map 84px; map decor 78px; desk lights 70px

stickers.note: regular uses the web wt-stk filter (thicker border), _sm uses wt-stk-sm; guitar_<skin> are the shop guitar skins, plain guitar is classic

size.where: venue page poster 272x231px; map 190px (4.25 px per unit)

map.note: locked venues are a CSS filter in the web (grayscale, contrast .7, brightness 1.08, opacity .5), not separate art

scribble.where: stretched under text (about 80x7px); exported at its viewBox x2

glyphs.note: symbols the bundled fonts lack (BRIEF: drawn by the team in the same style), white for tinting; glyph = TMP sprite metrics in px at emPx per em (Editor/GlyphSetup builds the TMP sprite asset from them)

decor.note: CSS scrapbook pieces from the web stylesheets at 2x CSS px (device scale 2). Tiled pieces have a centre exactly tilePx wide and high, so the pattern continues; a partial last tile can leave a small seam before the right or bottom border

source.note: preserveAspectRatio none: stretch to the text width
.scrap > .torn: white paper, torn top and bottom, 6px hard shadow. Draw Tiled: the edge repeats every 60 css px
.torn.lined: notebook lines every 32 css px and the margin line at 34-36px. Draw Tiled
.torn.map: the map paper with its 28px grid (420 = lcm of 28 and the 60px edge). Draw Tiled

.tape: 96x26 fixed in the web, placed with .tl (top -10, left 14, rotate -8), .tr (top -10, right 14, rotate 7), .tc (top -12, centred, rotate -3). The web multiplies it over what is below (mix-blend-mode multiply); this PNG is the plain colour
.ticket with .tk-stub.perf: the 88px stub with its dashed seam and paper-coloured bites; 6px hard shadow. Draw Sliced. Text and the per-show barcode (ticket.js barcode()) are not in it
.stamp without its text ("sold out" in the hand font, accent-2); the web rotates it -14 deg
.desk at its remix size (752x274 css at 1920). Other heights stretch its dots and gradient; for those use desk_plain plus desk_dots tiled inside it. The web tilts it -.5 deg
.desk with only its gradient layer (the dot layer sized to 0). Sliced; the gradient runs top to bottom, ink from 60%
the .desk dot layer as one 9px tile (white at 13%); tile it inside desk_plain, clipped to its rounded inside
the coach speech bubble at 900px and wider (both coach bubbles at 1920 share this shape). Sliced; add bubble_tail on top
the .bubble::before tail; offset is from the bubble bottom centre (show coach: left 50%; home coach: left 48% of the bubble width). Draw after bubble: it covers the bubble border where they meet
body::before: 560px dot patch at top -80, right -80, fading out from the top-right window corner; opacity .75 baked in
body::after: 560px dot patch at bottom -100, left -100, fading out from the bottom-left window corner; opacity .75 baked in

tail.wag: rotate 0 -> 14 deg -> 0 over 1.1 s, ease-in-out, loop; not in sleepy

lids.blink: scaleY 0 (hidden) normally; 0 at 92%, 1 at 95%, 0 at 100% of 4.2 s, loop; idle only

zzz.float: translate (3, -5) units and opacity .55 at 50% of 2.4 s, ease-in-out, loop; delays 0, .4, .8 s (with their _ink and _pad)

animation.head: think and oops tilts are baked into dog_head_think / dog_head_oops and their outfit layers

map.route: not exported as sprites: draw it from these curves (SVG path data in layout units, stretched to the map rect, preserveAspectRatio none). Web order: under (curveAll), then done (curveDone[reached], none when reached is 0), then dash (curveAll)
